tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i mngon rtogs bzhugs//

༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsgrub pa'i thabs phyi nang gzhan gsum gsal ba zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ ni rgyal ba kun gyi sku ste mkha' 'dra sku gnyis rnam par 'phro// āḥli ka li brjod med gsung ni rnam dag gsung dbyangs drug cu ldan// hūm̐ ni rnam kun mchog ldan thugs te ye shes thugs rje tshad med pa// sku gsum dang ldan dkyil 'khor 'khor lo de la gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lam gyis ni// sgrub pa'i thabs 'di mdo bzhin du// 'phags pa thugs rje che ldan pas// mdzad pa bde blag rtogs phyir ro// 'dir rgyud kyi rgyal po dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i bsgrub pa pos/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la brtson par 'dod pas/ dgon pa dben pa'am yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ stan 'jam pa la sems dpa'i dkyil mo dkrung gis 'dug ste bsgom par bya'o// gnas kyi nges pa'o// de nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can de kho na nyid ma mthong ba rnams la snying rje chen po tshad med pa bskyed la/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bus yum reg bya rdo rje ma la 'khyud pas rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa/ zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje dkyil dkrung gis bzhugs par mos te/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems las/ mkhar oṃ āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rig las mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rnam pa bskyed pa/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du spros la/ mdzad pa du mas sems can zhe sdang can la sogs pa thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par dag par byas nas sangs rgyas kyi sprin du gyur te/ tshur 'dus nas rdo rje 'chang la bsdus pas rgyal ba thams cad mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin dang bcas par bltas te snying rje chen po la dmigs pa'o// de nas bsdus pa de rdo rje 'chang la thim pas zhe sdang rdo rje nyid du gyur te/

sku mdog in tra ni la lta bu zhal gsum phyag drug pa g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba rdo rje 'khor lo pad ma g.yas dang*/ dril bu rin chen ral gri g.yon na bsnams pa/ nyi ma la bzhugs par gyur te/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ snying khar hūm̐ bkod la bdag bsrung bar bya'o// de nas gnas bsrung bar bya ba'i don du/ 'od zer las 'og gi phyogs su hūm̐ spros pa la rdo rje'i sa gzhi sra zhing brtan pa de'i steng du bh+rum̐ las byung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa de la ma rig pa'i pam̐ las pad ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i gdan bcu las byung ba'i khro bcu spro ba ni/ shar du gshin rje gshed nag po g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas na dbyug pa rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon na sdig 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang dril bu dgra sta can no// lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas rnams rdo rje dang dbyug pa ral gri/ g.yon thugs kar sdig 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang dril bu dgra sta can no// nub tu rta mgrin dmar po g.yas nag g.yon dkar po/ phyag g.yas rnams pad ma ral gri gtun shing*/ g.yon na dril bu dgra sta zhags pa can no// byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang khu g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas rnams sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtun shing*/ g.yon sdig 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang dril bu dgra sta can no// shar lhor mi g.yo ba sngon po g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas rnams ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon sdig 'dzub dgra sta zhags pa can no// lho nub tu 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya can/ g.yas rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon zhags pa lcags kyu'o// nub byang du dbyug sngon sngon po g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas rnams dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon sdig 'dzub pad ma dgra sta can no// byang shar du stobs po che sngon po g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/

g.yas rnams dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo// g.yon sdig 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang*// ral gri dgra sta can no// sbrul gyi rgyan pa'o// steng du 'khor lo 'gyur ba sku mdog sngon po g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis spyi bor gtsug gtor gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa/ g.yas rdo rje pad ma dang*/ g.yon sdig 'dzub ral gri can no// 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po g.yas dmar g.yon dkar po/ g.yas rnams rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ g.yon sdig 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang pad ma ral gri 'dzin pa ste/ thams cad g.yon brkyang bas pad ma dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ khros pa spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba khro bo'i chas dang ldan pa'o// yang gzhan gtsug gtor 'dod rgyal mi g.yo ba gnod mdzes bzhi rin po che'i rgyan can/ gzhan rnams sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rang 'od kyi rig ma dang bcas par bsgom par bshad do// de nas gnod mdzes zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje tho ba dang g.yon zhags pa lcags kyu can spros te/ rang nyid kyi drung du 'khod pa las bka' bsgo ba/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gh+ri h+na gh+ri h+na hūm̐/ gh+ri h+na pa ya gh+ri h+na pa ya hūm̐/ a na ya ho/ bha ga ban bh+yi r+ya ra dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod pas phyogs bcur spros la phyogs skyong bcus bgegs kyi tshogs rnams rang dbang med par lcags kyus phug zhags pas bcings nas khro bo rnams kyi drung du bkug nas/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa las stod rang 'dra ba smad phur bu lta bu bcu 'phros pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor gnas pa la/ oṃ gha gha gha ta ya gha ta yā/ sarba du ṣ+ṭan phaṭa phaṭaḥ ki lā ya ki lā ya/ sarba pa pam̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra ki lā ya/ badz+ra dha ra ag dzña pa ya ti/ sarba bhin nan ka ya bāg tsi ta/ badz+ra ki la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces phur bu thob cig par bka' bsgo bas gnod mdzes kyis phur bu btab cing g.yo ba med par byas te/

nyon mongs pa thams cad bsgral nas bde ba chen por bya'o// de ma thag tu oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la rka hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i me phyogs bcur spros la gnod byed rnams bsreg par bya'o// yang oṃ ta ki ni hūm̐ dzā hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ zhes steng 'og gi sa gzhi dang ra ba bla re rdo rjer byin gyis brlab po// 'di ni kun rdzob bsrung ba bka'i 'khor lo spro ba'o// de nas don dam pa'i bsrung ba byas te/ dngos po med pa bsgom pa med// bsgom par bya ba bsgoms pa med// de ltar dngos po dngos med pa// bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// zhes brjod la srid pa gsum gyi brtan pa dang g.yo ba thams cad stong pa nyid du bya'o// 'di ni phyi ru 'jig rten gyi khams me dang chu dang rlung gis zhig pa dang*/ nang du mkhris pa dang bad kan dang*/ rlung gi khams kyis gzhan du 'chi ba na/ phyi ma 'grub pa'i rgyu nye bar sbyor ba ste sbyang ba dang*/ mthar thug tu stong pa nyid kho na bsrung ba'i mchog tu bstan pa yin no// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo stong pa nyid du bsdu ba dang bcas pa'o// de nas phyi 'jig rten gyi khams sems kyi snang ba'i cha las byung ba ltar rten bskyed pa ni/ sems kyi rdo rje 'chang na tha'i 'od zer las/ nam mkha'i dbyings su hūm̐ gis rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam nag po/ hūm̐ ram̐ hūm̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po/ hūm̐ lam̐ hūm̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po thams cad steng 'og hūm̐ las rdo rjes mtshan pa'o// 'byung bzhi gcig tu zhu zhing 'dres pa las rdo rje rgya gram shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus kyi lte ba mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang*// zur bzhi dang ni sgo bzhi dang*// rta babs bzhi ni mdzes par byas// gdung bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan// ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes// dra ba dra ba phyed pa dang*// rdo rje nor bu zla phyed brgyan// sgo dang sgo khyud 'tshams rnams su// rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras// bum pa ka ba rdo rje che// bre yi phreng ba rim bzhin gnas// ba dan dril bus rnam par mdzes// rnga yab la sogs kyis brgyan pa'o// de'i nang du rang bzhin du grub pa'i brten pa bskyed pa ni pad ma dang rang gi phyag mtshan dang khro bo rnams nyi ma lha mo dang sems dpa' zla ba la/

rgyal ba rnams nyi zla'i steng du skad cig gis lta'o// dbus su rdo rje 'chang zhal gsum phyag drug pa reg rdo rje dang bcas zhe sdang rdo rje lta bu'o// gzhan thams cad kyang 'og nas ston pa'i phyag mtshan dang rnam pa lta bu ste/ de la rim pa dang po'i shar lho nub byang du/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ 'od dpag med dang*/ don yod grub pa'o// me dang bden bral dang rlung dang dbang ldan du/ spyan ma dang ma ma ki dang gos dkar mo dang sgrol ma'o// de'i 'tshams phyi ma bzhir me nas gzugs rdo rje/ sgra rdo rje/ dri rdo rje/ ro rje'o/ reg ni sngar bstan to// rim pa gnyis par/ shar du byams pa dang sa'i snying po/ lhor phyag na rdo rje dang nam mkha'i snying po'o// nub tu 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dpal/ byang du sgrib pa rnam sel dang kun tu bzang po rnams so// rim pa gsum par sgo la sogs pa shar na gshin rje gshed la sogs pa bsrung 'khor du bstan pa bzhin no// de ltar dkyil 'khor thams cad ye shes kyi rang bzhin du grub pa/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas bskul te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad mchod sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad de/ sems can thams cad kyis dkyil 'khor mthong nas dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas lhar gyur par bsam mo// de dag ni sa'i cha dang gzhal yas dang dkyil 'khor bkod pa lhag par mos pa'o// 'di ni phyi rol du bskal pa dang po'i rdzus te skyes pa dang*/ nang du bar ma do'i dri za'i lus sbyong ba ste/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku la longs spyod rdzogs par snang ba'i don to/ de nas rang nyid la lus kyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug ste/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rigs thams cad spyi bor ro// de bzhin du mgrin par 'od dpag med/ snying kar mi bskyod pa lte bar rin chen 'byung ldan/

rkang ba gnyis 'dus sar don yod grub pa/ spyan ma la sogs pa ni khams bzhi la/ mig tu sa'i snying po rna bar phyag na rdo rje/ sna la nam mkha'i snying po/ lce la 'jig rten dbang phyug yid la 'jam dpal/ gsang bar sgrib pa rnam sel/ rtsa la byams pa/ tshigs la kun tu bzang po/ lag pa g.yas gshin rje gshed/ g.yon gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ kha la rta mgrin/ rdo rje la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ dpung pa g.yas mi g.yo ba/ g.yon 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ pus mo g.yas dbyug sngon/ g.yon stobs po che/ spyi bor gtsug gtor 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ rkang mthil du gnod mdzes rnams bsdus te thams cad rang nyid du byas nas/ rang nyid kyang don dam par bsdus te de yang bde ba chen po'i 'od gsal bar byas so// 'di ni bar do de yang bde ba chen po'i skad cig tu zhugs pas mngal du sbyor ba'i don to// ye shes kyi rim pa ni/ gzugs phung gtogs pa me long dang*/ sa khams mig gi dbang po dang*// gzugs kyang lnga par 'gyur ba ste// khro bo gnyis dang yang dag ldan// tshor ba'i phung po mnyam nyid dang*// chu khams sna yi dbang po dang// sgra yang lnga par gyur pa ste// khro bo gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ 'du shes so sor rtog pa dang*// byin za sna yi dbang po dang*/ dri yang lnga par 'gyur ba ste// khro bo gnyis dang yang dag ldan// 'du byed bya ba grub pa dang*// rlung khams lce yi dbang po dang*// ro yang lnga par 'gyur ba ste// khro bo gnyis dang yang dag ldan// steng 'og khro bo gnyis dang bcas// rang bzhin gyis ni snang ba nyid// rnam shes phung por zhugs pa ste// rnam shes kyang ni 'od gsal ba'o// mya ngan 'das bcas kun stong ba// chos kyi skur yang bshad pa yin/ zhes bya ba'i don dran par byas la/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzña na badz+ra sa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ zhes brtan par byas te snang ba med cing mtshan ma med pa'i don dam pa nyid du bzhag go

/don dam la 'jug pa'o// de nas mngal nas skye ba'i sprul pa chen po bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ldang bar bya ba ni/ 'od gsal ba las hūm̐ de las 'phro ba'i sbyor bas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid dmar ba'i rang bzhin/ de'i steng du zla ba gang ba me long lta bu dag dkar cha'i ngo bo de'i steng du pad ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang bcas pa so sor rtog pa bar do rnam shes srog rlung dang bcas pa/ de rnams zla ba la zhugs pas brtan pa khams dang g.yo ba rnam par shes pa cig tu 'dres shing bya ba nan tan ye shes bzhi cig tu bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ dharma dhar tu sa bha bā ad ma ko ham̐/ zhes brjod pa ni sbyor ba'o// de nas yi ge gsum dang bcas pa'i zla ba las gyur pa'i rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa las/ dang po'i mgon po zhal cig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa ku mu ta ltar dkar bar gyur par blta ste/ lus rdzogs pa'i rgyu rjes su sbyor ba'o// de la skad cig gis rang bzhin gyis mi skyod par zhugs pas/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa in tra ni la ltar sngo ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri can du gyur nas phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad mngon par grub pa'i lhar dgod pa ni*/ phyi bor oṃ dkar po gzugs kyi phung po'i rang bzhin rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par a dmar po/ 'du shes kyi phung po 'od dpag med/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pa/ lte bar sa ser po tshor ba'i phung po rin chen 'byung ldan/ rkang pa gnyis 'dus par ha ljang ku 'du byed kyi phung po don yod grub pa/ lus kyi sa'i khams la lam̐ las spyan ma/ gsher ba'i khams las mam̐ la ma ma ki/ dro ba'i khams la pam̐ las gos dkar mo/ rlung gi khams la ham̐ las sgrol ma'o// mig tu tha

lha ིཾ dkar po las sa'i snying po rna bar oṃ sngon po las phyag na rdo rje/ sna la oṃ ser po las nam mkha'i snying po/ lce la āḥdamar po la 'jig rten dbang phyug snying khar yid la hūm̐ sngon po las 'jam dpal/ lus la oṃ ljang khu las sgrib pa rnam sel/ rtsa rgyud la mā+ai dkar po las byams pa/ tshigs rnams la sam̐ sngon po las kun tu bzang po'o// khro bo rnams ni hūm̐ las byung pa ste rta mgrin dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ dmar ba dang ljang khu gzhan thams cad sngo nag go /lag pa g.yas gshin rje gshed/ g.yon gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ kha la rta mgrin/ gsang bar bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ dpung pa g.yas mi g.yo ba g.yon 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ pus mo g.yas dbyug sngon/ g.yon stobs po che/ spyi bor gtsug gtor 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ rkang mthing gnyis la gnod mdzes rnams 'god de/ de ltar sku'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ shin du sbyor ba zhes bya'o// nang du zla ba bcus lus rdzogs pa dang*/ phyir las kyi dngos grub mngon par shes pa la sogs 'grub pa'i phyir bsgom par bya'o// de nas sbyor ba chen pos sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa/ rang gi spyi bo zla ba la oṃ dkar po 'od lnga 'phro ba bsams te de las lha mo spyan ma du ma spros las/ sku rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' gang ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku spyan drangs nas/ de'i dbus kyi gtso bo mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad dang ldan pa bsgoms la/ gsol ba gdab pa/ dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang pa// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// rdo rje skur ni mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// rdo rje'i skur ni mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod nas spyan dang rnam par snang mdzad dbyer med par bcug ste/

sku byin gyis brlabs nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin// phung po lnga yis rab gang ba// sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo yis// bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta ka ya badz+ra swa bha ad ma ko haṃ gis brtan par bya'o// yang rang gi mgrin par pad ma la aḥdamar po gnas pa la gos dkar mo du ma spros nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad gsung rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bkug nas/ chos kyi gsung mnga' dpal dang ldan// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// de dag byin gyis brlabs nas su// rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod pas dbyer med du gyur par bsgoms te ngag la byin gyis brlabs par bsgoms la/ rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin// nges pa'i tshig ni phun sum tshogs// bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra zhing*// chos 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar shog oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta badz+ra swa bha bā ad ma ko ham̐ zhes brtan par bya'o// yang snying khar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po bsgom nas/ sngar ltar ma ma ki spros la/ thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod nas gnyis su med par snying khar bcug nas thugs byin gyis brlabs te/ kun tu bzang po'i thugs gang yin// gsang ba'i bdag po blo ldan pa// bdag kyang de dang 'drar gyur cing*// rdo rje 'dzin dang mtshungs par shog /oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta tsi ta badz+ra swa bha bā ad ma ko haṃ zhes brtan par bya'o// de nas rigs gsum bdag nyid yin pa'i nga rgyal bskyed la/

oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā gha ta ka ya bā ga tsi ta badz+ra swa bha bā ad ma ko ham̐/ zhes brjod do// de ltar dam tshig sems dpa' grub ma thag tu sangs rgyas thams cad dang gcig tu gyur pa'i rtags su snying kar rang lta bu'i ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dmar po zla ba'i gdan la bskyed do/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ sngon po phra ba bsgoms te/ rang gi rig pa ye shes kyi thig ler gyur bar bsam mo// 'di rnams ni lus can rnams skyes nas so skyes kyi bar du sku dang*/ de nas so lhung gi bar ngag byin gyis brlab pa de nas lo bcu drug gi bar bsam pa rdzogs par byed pa yid byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ de nyid dbang bskur ba byis pa'i dbang bdun du'ang gsungs so// sems dpa' gsum dgod pa'o// de ltar bsnyen pa rdzogs nas phyag rgya'i bsgrub pa sme shwa can nam/ gzhan ma ma ki yid las byung ba gzugs mdzes pa sngo sangs sgeg pa rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa spros pa byin gyi brlabs te spyi bor oṃ mgrin par āḥsnying khar hūm̐/ lte bar swa/ rkang bar ha/ sa chu me rlung gi khams la ni spyan ma dang ma ma ki gos dkar mo sgrol ma'o// mig tu gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna bar sgra rdo rje ma/ sna la dri rdo rje ma lce la ro rdo rje ma/ lus la reg rdo rje ma/ yang snying khar yid la thugs rdo rje ma tshigs rnams la sku rdo rje ma'o// de bzhin du khro mo bcu ni lag pa g.yas su rdo rje ro langs ma/ g.yon du gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ kha la khro gnyer ma/ gsang bar ral cig ma/ dpung pa g.yas su rdo rje ma/ g.yon du sna tshogs rin chen ma/ pus mo g.yas sna tshogs pad ma/ g.yon sna tshogs las ma/ spyi bor mkha' rdo rje ma/ rkang pa sa 'dzin lha mo rnams lha'i rnam pa'am/ sa bon ni thabs rnams dang mthun no// 'di rnams ni thabs dang shes rab ro mnyam par bya'o/ de nas thabs kyi rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa oṃ gyis mtshan pa dang*/

shes rab kyi mkha' las byung ba'i pad ma 'dab ma brgyad par byin gyis brlab po// de nas 'od zer lnga'i 'phro 'dus rang nyid rin chen tog gi nga rgyal du byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ka ta badz+ra sa bha bā ad ma ko haṃ zhes brjod do// yang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal legs 'chang zhing*// hūm̐ gis kyang ni rab bskyod nas// rang gi byang chub sems ni 'byung ba'i tshe// der ni phaṭa kyi gsang sngags brjod par bya// de nas byang chub kyi sems kyi cha cig gis phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad bde ba chen po dang mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod cing*// rnga sgra'i nga rgyal gyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu tsa badz+ra sa bha bā ad ma ko ham̐ zhes byin gyis brlab po// rjes su chags pa dang mnyes par bya ba des ni sems kyi rdo rje 'chang lus rdzogs pa khams drug dang ldan par grub cing sbyong bar 'gyur ro// de yan chad ni bdag gi don phun sum tshogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/// /de nas gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa'i phyir/ yum gyi mkha' nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ so so'i sngags la lha thams cad spro ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dh+rig hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa mthing ka zhal gsum phyag drug pa g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ so so'i g.yas kyi phyag gsum rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ 'khor lo pad ma dmar po g.yon gsum gyis dril bu dang rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ yum dang bcas pa spros pas phyogs bcu thams cad du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa kun mdzad nas sems can thams cad zhe sdang rnam par dag pa rdo rje can gyi gnas la bkod nas/ tshur 'dus pas rang nyid la chu la chu thim pa ltar gyur pas/ rang nyid kyang zhe sdang rdo rje snga ma las ches 'od 'bar ba rtsa ba'i zhal drag po g.yas zhi ba g.yon sgeg cing chags pa 'od zer dmar po 'bar ba nyi ma'i gdan la dkyil dkrung gi bzhugs pa/

yum reg bya rdo rje ma rang lta bus 'khyud par gyur par blta'o// de yang 'khor spro ba ni oṃ a dzī nā dzig hūm̐ las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i zhi ba'i tshul can/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na 'khor lo rdo rje pad ma/ g.yon gsum na dril bu rin chen ral gri can spros la sems can thams cad gti mug rnam par dag pa'i gnas la bkod nas tshur byon te shar phyogs su zla ba la bzhugs so// oṃ āḥrd na dh+rig hūm̐ las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas rnams rin po che dang rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon na dril bu pad ma ser po ral gri can spros nas sems can thams cad nga rgyal rnam par dag pa'i gnas la bkod nas/ lhor rin po che la bzhugs so// oṃ āḥ.a ro lig hūm̐ las 'od dpag tu med pa dmar po zhal g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag drug gi dang po g.yon gyis dril bu dang pad ma'i sdong po 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi thugs kar 'byed pa mdzad pa 'og ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo g.yon gnyis rin po che dang ral gri can/ sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa spros la sems can thams cad 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i gnas la bkod nas/ nub tu pad ma la bzhugs so// oṃ ā prad dzña dh+rig hūm̐ las don yod rdo rje ljang khu zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas rnams ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon rnams dril bu pad ma ljang khu nor bu can spros la phrag dog can gyi sems can thams cad log pa'i nga rgyal rnam par dag pa'i gnas la bkod nas/ byang du rgya gram gyi steng du bzhugs so// rgyal ba 'di rnams rdo rje'i dkyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang*/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can rigs kyi bdag po mi skyod pa'i dbu rgyan pa yin no// oṃ a mo ha ra ti hūm̐ las spyan ma dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa rnam snang lta bu la g.yas tha ma ud pa la dkar po 'dzin pa spros la/

gdon dang nad thams cad zhi bar mdzad nas mer zla ba la bzhugs so// oṃ aḥdha she ra ti hūm̐ las ma ma ki sngon mo mi bskyod pa lta bu zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas tha mas ud pa la sngon po 'dzin pa spros la sems can thams cad kyi bgegs bsrung bar mdzad nas bden bral du bzhugs so/ oṃ āḥr ga ra ti hūm̐ las gos dkar mo dmar mo 'od dpag med lta bu pad ma'i dod du ud pa la dmar po can spros la sems can thams cad kyi gnod pa zhi bar byas nas rlung mtshams su bzhugs so// oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra ti hūm̐ las sgrol ma ljang khu zhal don yod grub pa lta bu las phyag drug gi g.yas gsum sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo ud pa la ljang khu/ g.yon gsum na dril bu rin chen ral gri can spros la sems can thams cad dbang du mdzad de dbang ldan du bzhugs so// rim pa gnyis pa mtshams bzhir/ oṃ āḥru pa badz+ra hūm̐ la gzugs rdo rje spyan ma lta bu la phyag dang po gnyis me long 'dzin pa me ru'o/ oṃ āḥsha pa ta badz+ra hūm̐ las sgra rdo rje ser mo ma ma ki lta bu la zhal g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba phyag dang po gnyis pi wang rdebs pa lho nub tu'o// oṃ āḥghan dhe badz+ra hūm̐ las dri rdo rje ma gos dkar mo lta bu phyag dang po gnyis kyis dri'i dung bsnams pa nub byang du'o// oṃ aḥr s+ye badz+ra hūm̐ las ro rdo rje ma sgrol ma ljang gu phyag dang po gnyis na lha'i zhal zas 'dzin pa byang shar du'o// oṃ āḥpar she badz+ra hūm̐ las reg rdo rje ma bdag po lta bu yum nyid la bsdus te bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin 'di rnams spros pas ni/ sems can thams cad la 'dod pa'i yon tan ster zhing sbyong la tshur rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mnyes par byed pa'o// rim pa gsum pa la shar du oṃ āḥmā+ai me tri na tha shri hūm̐ las byams pa rtsa rgyus sbyong zhing byams pas khyab par byed pa'o// me ru oṃ aḥtha

lha ིཾ k+ṣi de garba hūm̐ las sa'i snying po mig sbyong zhing lha'i mig rtsol ba ste/ gnyis ka rnam snang lta bu la byams pa'i g.yas dang po klu shing me tog bsnams pa'o// lho oṃ āḥ.oṃ badz+ra pa ni hūm̐ las phyag na rdo rje rna ba sbyong zhing sgra thams cad mkhyen par byed pa'o// lho nub du oṃ aḥ.oṃ kha ghar pa hūm̐ las nam mkha'i snying po sna sbyong zhing dri'i mngon shes rtsol ba ste gnyis kha rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu'o// nub tu oṃ āḥ.oṃ lo ki shwa ra hūm̐ las 'jig rten dbang phyug lce sbyong zhing ro'i mngon shes ster ba'o// nub byang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ man dzu shri hūm̐ las 'jam pa'i dbyangs thams cad du 'jug pa'i yid sbyong zhing gzhan gyi sems shes rtsol ba ste gnyis ka 'od dpag med lta bu'o// byang du oṃ aḥ.oṃ sarba gham̐ bhi ra hūm̐ las sgrib pa thams cad sel ba lus dag par byed cing rdo rje'i lus rtsol ba'o// byang shar du oṃ āḥsaṃ sa man ta bha tra hūm̐ las kun tu bzang po tshig rnams sbyong zhing lus kyi rdzu 'phrul ster bar mdzad pa ste gnyis ka rnga sgra lta bu'o// sgo dang 'tshams su// oṃ aḥya man ta krid hūm̐ phaṭa las gshin rje gshed nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba g.yas rnams dbyug pa rdo rje 'khor lo g.yon thugs kar sdig 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang*/ dril bu dgra sta can dbang po'i gdon skrag par mdzad pa shar du'o// oṃ āḥpra dzña ta krid hūm̐ phaṭa las shes rab mthar byed dkar po/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba phyag g.yas rdo rje dbyug pa ral gri/ g.yon thugs kar sdig 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang*/ dril bu dgra sta can/ gshin rje'i gdon bcom nas lho sgo ru'o// oṃ aḥpad man ta krid hūm̐ phaṭa las rta mgrin dmar po g.yas nag g.yon dkar po/ phyag g.yas pad ma ral gri gtun shing*/ g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas dril bu dang dgra sta zhags pa can/

klu rnams skrag par mdzad pa nub kyi sgo ru'o// oṃ aḥbig nan ta krid hūm̐ phaṭa las bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo gtun shing*/ g.yon gsum sdig 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang dril bu dgra sta can/ bgegs phur bus 'debs pa byang gi sgo ru'o// oṃ aḥ.ar+ya a tsa la hūm̐ phaṭa las mi g.yo ba sngon po zhal g.yas dmar ba g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo g.yon gsum na sdig 'dzub dgra sta zhags pa can/ yams la sogs pa bcom nas shar lho 'tshams su bzhugs so// o aḥta kri ra tsa hūm̐ phaṭa las 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya can/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje ral gri g.yon zhags pa lcags kyu can srin po'i gdon skrag par mdzad pa lho nub tu bzhugs so// oṃ aḥni la dhan ta hūm̐ phaṭa las dbyug pa sngon po mthing kha g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum sdig 'dzub pad ma dgra sta can nad kyi 'jigs pa bsal nas nub byang du bzhugs so// oṃ aḥm hā ba la hūm̐ phaṭa las stobs po che sngon po zhal g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba phyag g.yas gsum dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum snying khar sdig 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang ral gri dgra sta can sbrul gyis brgyan pa mkha' 'gro'i 'jigs pa bcom nas byang shar du bzhugs so/ oṃ āḥ.u sh+ṇi sha tsakra war ti hūm̐ phaṭa las gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba sngo bsangs zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba phyag dang po gnyis gtsug gtor 'dzin pa g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje pad ma g.yon gnyis sdig 'dzub ral gri can 'tshe ba thams cad bcom nas steng gi phyogs su bzhugs so/ oṃ aḥsum bha ra tsa hūm̐ phaṭa las gnod mdzes nam mkha'i mdog can zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che g.yon sdig 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang pad ma ral gri can dug dang bgegs thams cad bcom nas sa 'og tu bzhugs so// khro bo thams cad nyi ma la g.yon brkyang pa'i zhabs kyis bzhugs pa rin po che'i rgyan dang khro bo chas dang ldan pa/

gsus pa 'phyang ba spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pas 'jigs par byed pa'o// lha thams cad kyang steng 'og dang reg rdo rje mi bskyod pas brgyan pa'o// shar dang me rnams rnam snang lho dang bden bral gyi lha rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub dang rlung gi rnams 'od dpag med/ byang dang dbang ldan rnams don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan can no// de ltar gzhan gyi don phun sum 'tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad bskyed nas sku gsung thugs byin brlabs dang ye shes sems dpa' rang chas su gnas pa'o// ting 'dzin sems dpa' ni thugs khar so so'i sa bon bkod de ngag gi bzlas pa la spro bsdu'i tshe dgos phyir ro// de ltar gsal bar bsgom pa ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin to// 'di rnams ni phyi rol tu lus rdzogs pa'i skyes bu bu dang bu mo 'byin pa dang las thams cad byed pa'i 'khrul pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ mthar thug ye shes thob pa na gzugs kyi sku rnam pa gnyis kyis sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul brjod pa yin no// yang lha'i sku rdzogs pa ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ btsun mo ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya sngags kyi yi ge ni chos kyi phyag rgya sna tshogs pa'i sems can gyi don byed cing bsgrub pa las kyi phyag rgya'o// de ltar rgyas btab pa ni gzhan gyi don sgrub par byed pa'o// de nas phra mo'i rnal 'byor bsgoms te sngar bstan pa ltar lha thams cad kyi mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas bde ba chen po'i sbyor bas byang chub kyi sems bdag gi gsang bar yungs dkar gyi tshad tsam yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa bsgom mo// sna yi rtse mor yungs dkar bsam// 'gro dang mi 'gro yungs dkar la// gsang ba'i sngags kyis btags pa yi// ye shes mchog gi gnas bsgom mo// zhes bya ba byang chub kyi sems kyi phra mo'o// rlung gi phra mo ni rang nyid dang lha thams cad kyi'ang rung ste steng gi sna rtser rlung lnga'i ngo bo kha dog lnga dang ldan pa yungs dkar tsam la brtan par bzhag la/

sems brtan par gyur pa dang*/ kha dog lnga dang ldan pa'i 'od rgya cher spros la snod dang bcud thams cad khyab nas lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi sprin du gsal bar bsgom par bya'o// rin chen kha dog rnam pa lnga/ yungs dkar gyi ni 'bru tshod tsam// sna yi rtse mor nan tan du// rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu bsgom// rin chen ldan par gyur nas spro// brtan par ma gyur de mi spro// sangs rgyas 'bar ba'i 'od mnyam pa// rab mchog sprin ni spro bar bya// zhes gsungs pa ni ye shes kyi rim pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o// rdzogs rims ni 'dir mi brjod do/ de nas ngag gi bzlas pa ni spro bsdu dang las so so la dmigs pa gang yang rung ba/ oṃ aḥbadz+ra dhig hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā zhes bya ba la sogs pa sngar brjod pa bzlas so// de yang zhi ba sgra chung ngu dang khro bo drag tu bzlas par bshad do// de nas dkyil 'khor dang bzlas pa'i rim par 'dzin pa de don dam par 'jug pa ni/ gtso bo'i gnas lnga na sa bon gnas pa thams cad snying kha'i hūm̐ la 'od lnga dang ldan pa'i thig ler bsdus la rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid bsgom mo// de ltar de bzhin nyid du zhugs pa la/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis sems can gyi don du glus bskul bar bya ste/ thog mar spyan mas byams pa tshad med pas bskul ba// sems can khams na gnas pa'i dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs// dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pa bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ mgon po gal te bdag ni de ring gson par mchis bzhed na/ sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol// ma ma kis snying rje tshad med pas bskul ba/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan// sangs rgyas don du byang chub mchog bsgrub rab tu phan par gzigs/ mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na// 'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol// gos dkar mos dga' ba tshad med pas bskul ba// khyod ni rdo rje gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba// 'jig rten dag ni dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rab tu brtson// mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na// spyod pa dri med kun tu bzang po bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol// sgrol mas btang snyoms tshad med pas bskul ba// khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs te dam tshig mchog gi phan don che// yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs la// mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na// yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ces bskul ba snga ma ltar bzhengs nas de ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bstod par mdzad de/

thog mar zhe sdang rdo rje rang nyid kyi thugs ka nas mi bskyod pa spros pas bstod pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsung mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par snang mdzad kyis bstod pa/ rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen 'byung ldan gyis bstod pa/ rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// dngos nyid dag pa gos pa med// gsang ba'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// 'od dpag med kyis/ rdo rje mi mchi rgyal po che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// don yod grub pas bstod pa/ rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod nas de'i 'og tu gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor thams cad la mchod cing*/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas lha thams cad mnyes par byas nas thun bsdu bar 'dod pas thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros nas dkyil 'khor thams cad lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bsdu'o// lus kyi dkyil 'khor ye shes sems dpa' la/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la/ de hūm̐ las bsdu'o// yang de ma thag tu hūm̐ las 'od zer byung nas yi ge hūm̐ gis nam mkha'i khams bkang ste sems can thams cad la thim pas rdo rje sems dpa' zhal cig phyag gnyis par gyur te thams cad bsdus nas/ mgon po bde ba chen po cig tu zhugs par gyur to// rim pa 'di rnams ni 'dir bdag nyid chen po klu grub kyis/ mir gyur pa khams bzhi brtas par byed pa'i phyir/ gnyid dang bza' ba dang reg pa dang yid la byed pas yang nas yang du bskul ba de sbyong ba'i phyir lha mos bskul ba dang*/
